correctness.rationale: All quantifiers N=2^a>=8, five distinct columns and fixed rows are explicit. The alternant identity is standard and its integer cases verified. Cyclotomic reduction yields opposite edge pairs; with an antipodal vertex pair it forces a quartet, while without one the matching omission argument gives same-parity descent and induction. The converse, rank 4 subminor and unique coset count complete the proof. Exact integer tests of all 205800 subsets up to N32 support but do not replace the infinite argument.
